title: Reunion of Siblings
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought everything had settled, three dark cyan messenger flames suddenly lit up the night sky beyond the Forbidden Grounds—the highest-level alarm of the Tianqing Sect.

text.content: The voice was like a key long sealed away, suddenly inserted into the deepest lock of Chen Ji's heart. Familiar enough to freeze him entirely. It was his sister's voice—the voice of Chen Nian, his sister who had been missing for years, whom he had believed to be long dead. 'Ji-gege... is that you?' Chen Ji's fingers clenched tightly, his knuckles turning white. Without hesitation, he turned and rushed toward where the voice came from. Thorns tore through his robes, stones crumbled beneath his feet, but he felt nothing, his mind consumed by a single thought—find her.

dialogue.content: 'Ji-gege! Don't come over here! This is a trap!' Chen Nian's voice suddenly rose, filled with terror and despair, 'They... they knew you would come all along!' Chen Ji's footsteps halted abruptly, but instead of retreating, he pressed forward with even greater determination. Moonlight filtered through the dense forest, casting mottled shadows across his face, yet his eyes were cold as millennium-old glacial ice. 'A trap?' A hint of sarcasm curved the corner of his lips, 'That saves me the trouble of hunting them down one by one.' His voice was soft, yet carried an unsettling certainty. Twelve years. Twelve years of planning, twelve years of endurance, twelve years of midnight dreams—today, it all ends.

text.content: Passing through the final thicket, the scene before Chen Ji made his pupils constrict sharply. It was an underground stone chamber sealed deep within the Forbidden Grounds, its walls covered密密麻麻 with countless restriction runes, glowing with an eerie dark purple light. And at the very center of the chamber, within a cage forged from black iron, a young girl in plain white prison garments gazed at him quietly. Her face was pale to the point of translucence, heartbreakingly thin, but those eyes—those eyes identical to his own—remained clear and bright, like stars burning in the darkness. Chen Nian. His sister. They gazed at each other through the cage bars, separated by mere zhang, yet feeling as if twelve years of time itself lay between them.

dialogue.content: 'Ji-gege... you've changed so much.' Chen Nian's voice trembled slightly, her eyes reddening, yet she stubbornly held back her tears. 'The old you... would never have smiled like that.' Chen Ji was momentarily stunned, then concealed that cold smile, walking slowly toward the cage. His fingers gently traced the black iron bars, an intensely chilling sensation spreading from his fingertips throughout his entire body. 'Nian-er,' his voice was low and tender, as if he were still that boy who would secretly bring her sugar-coated hawthorns, 'tell big brother, who locked you in here?' Chen Nian's lips quivered, a complex emotion flickering across her gaze. 'The Holy Sect...' her voice was soft, yet carried bone-deep hatred, 'they said I am the key to opening the final pages of the Tianji Record.' She slowly raised her right hand, and only then did Chen Ji notice a faint golden pattern on her wrist, emitting the same glow as the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He looked down at the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace, its golden light resonating with the pattern on Chen Nian's wrist, as if some ancient bloodline pact was awakening. 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key...' he murmured, repeating the name, his heart掀起惊涛骇浪. The complete form of the Tianji Record actually requires blood relatives as a sacrifice? His fingers clenched the bars tightly, his knuckles white from the force. The truth behind his sister's disappearance twelve years ago, the answers he had pursued desperately for twelve years—turned out to be this残酷. 'What did they... do to you?' Chen Ji's voice was dangerously low, every word seeming to be挤出 from between his teeth. Chen Nian lowered her head, her voice barely a whisper: 'They... extract my essence blood every day, to activate the Tianji Record Fragment the Holy Sect seized.' She raised her other arm, and Chen Ji saw countless needle puncture marks covering it,触目惊心. 'But Ji-gege, my bloodline still has one final sliver of power,' she lifted her head, a glimmer of hope burning in her eyes, 'it can help you open the third page of the Tianji Record—but the cost is, my lifespan will decrease by ten years.'

choice.prompt: Chen Ji faced with his sister's proposed sacrifice plan, his heart激烈struggling. What choice should he make?

choices.description: Under no circumstances allow his sister to be hurt again, find another way to open the third page of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_cost: Give up the awakening opportunity of the Tianji Record's third page
choices.visible_reward: Protect Chen Nian's lifespan, siblings' emotions elevated
choices.risk_hint: Might miss the critical timing to break the deadlock

text.content: 'No way!' Chen Ji's voice suddenly rose, almost shouting, 'I searched for you for twelve years, not for you to sacrifice for me again!' His hands gripped the bars tightly, his knuckles white, 'Tell me, is there another way? Even if there's only a sliver of possibility, I won't let you lose a single day of your life!' Chen Nian stared at him blankly, tears finally spilling from her eyes. Twelve years—this was the first time she had cried in front of her brother.

choices.description: Time is pressing, to break the Holy Sect's conspiracy, temporarily accept Chen Nian's sacrifice plan
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian's lifespan decreases by ten years
choices.visible_reward: The third page of Tianji Record awakens, obtaining the ability to trace cause and effect
choices.risk_hint: A rift may develop between the siblings

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, those deep eyes flickering with endless struggle and heartache. But in the end, he slowly nodded. 'Nian-er,' his voice was low and hoarse, 'I'm sorry... big brother came too late.' He reached out, gently stroking his sister's cheek through the bars, 'But I swear, this debt, I will make the Holy Sect repay a hundredfold.' Chen Nian's tears turned into a smile, that smile carrying both relief and determination. 'Ji-gege, we face this together.'

choices.description: Use existing resources to find other solutions, such as requesting Ye Qing's help or exploring possibilities within the Tianji Record itself
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming significant time and resources
choices.visible_reward: May find a method that doesn't require Chen Nian's sacrifice, while deepening cooperation with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: Time is pressing, may not be able to make it in time

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered with a cunning gleam. "Nian'er, show me the patterns on your wrist." He extended his right hand, and the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm trembled slightly, golden light interweaving with the patterns on Chen Nian's wrist. "Tianji Record..." he murmured. "Since you can activate it, it must have something to give you in return." He closed his eyes, his consciousness diving deep into the Tianji Record. A moment later, his eyes snapped open. "I've got it! Mo Xiansheng said the third page of the Tianji Record contains the power of 'Causality Retracing'—but I never said we had to trade your life for it!"

dialogue.content: At this moment, an ancient and distant voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind: "You've progressed, boy." It was Mo Xiansheng. Chen Ji's consciousness trembled slightly as a vague face appeared on the Tianji Record Fragment—the mysterious soul guardian. "The awakening of the third page does require a 'key'," Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of approval, "but sacrificing bloodline is not the only path." On Chen Nian's wrist, the golden patterns suddenly glowed, as if sensing something. "You are Chen Xuan's inheritor, and naturally carry the bloodline to open the Tianji Record. And she is your soul fragment of resonant origin—" Mo Xiansheng's voice gradually deepened. "If you connect through the 'Shared Destiny' technique, the Tianji Record will merge the two bloodline powers into one, rather than devouring one to fuel the other." Chen Ji's eyes lit up sharply, then quickly dimmed. "What would be the consequences of the Shared Destiny technique...?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, his voice carrying an elusive nuance: "After Shared Destiny, when your Heavenly Fate is consumed, she will feel it. And when her fate fluctuates, you cannot stand aside." Chen Ji raised his head sharply, his gaze meeting Chen Nian's in the air. In that instant, he understood his sister's meaning—she was willing. "Ji-gege," Chen Nian's voice was soft, yet extraordinarily firm, "We're family. Twelve years... I don't want to be separated from you again." Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly closed his eyes. When he opened them again, there was no hesitation in those eyes. He pressed his palm against the cage bars, and the Tianji Record Fragment flew from his掌心, golden light blazing. "Alright." Only one word, yet heavy as a thousand catties. The next moment, golden light glowed simultaneously on both siblings' wrists, the two beams intertwining, weaving, merging—a mighty force erupted from their connected bloodlines! The Tianji Record Fragment shook violently as the third page slowly turned, revealing dense ancient runes! At that moment, a system notification rang in Chen Ji's mind—"Ding! Third page of Tianji Record awakened! Acquired Causality Retracing Ability! Host can trace past causes and effects to gain insight into the origin and essence of all things!"

Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power surging through his body. The barrier of Transformation God stage initial realm crumbled at this moment, his aura soaring madly. Surrounding spiritual energy from heaven and earth flowed into his body like a hundred rivers converging to the sea, creating tumultuous waves in his meridians. Core Formation stage initial... Core Formation stage middle... The swelling power finally began to calm. Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, faint golden light flickering in his pupils. He looked down at his hands, feeling the surging power within, a satisfied curve forming at the corner of his mouth. "Twelve years..." he murmured, "I've finally reached this point." Beside him, the golden patterns on Chen Nian's wrist had become even brighter, as if some shackle was loosening.

dialogue.content: Just then, a familiar transmission rang in Chen Ji's mind: "Ji-gege, I've invaded the Holy Sect's mountain defense formation, the restrictions have loosened. There's a secret passage to the northeast that leads directly to the periphery of the Forbidden Grounds." It was Chen Ling! A gleam of joy flashed in Chen Ji's eyes—this sister always surprised him at critical moments. "Also," Chen Ling's voice carried a hint of gravity, "Ye Qing's people have arrived for support outside. But the Holy Sect's pursuers will soon notice the abnormality—you must evacuate quickly." Chen Ji nodded, turning to look at Chen Nian. "Nian'er, can you move?" A flash of surprise crossed Chen Nian's eyes, then transformed into an understanding smile. "Did Ji-gege think my twelve years inside were spent idly?" She raised her hand, fingers gently touching the iron bars—golden light flowed, and that unbreakable iron actually began to slowly dissolve! "They extracted my essence blood, not knowing my bloodline had long merged with their restrictions." Chen Nian's voice was soft, yet carried a cold edge. "Disabling restrictions from the inside? I'm better at it than anyone else."

choice.prompt: Chen Nian successfully broke free from the cage, and the siblings were about to begin their escape. But there might be Holy Sect ambushes along the escape route—how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Use the newly breakthrough Core Formation realm and Causality Retracing ability to directly breakthrough the Holy Sect pursuers' blockade
choices.visible_cost: May expose strength and attract stronger enemies
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate enemies and greatly enhance reputation
choices.risk_hint: May consume large amounts of Heavenly Fate

text.content: Chen Jisneered一声，一把拉住陈念的手。"走，让哥哥带你回家。"他的声音calm，却带着一种睥睨天下的霸气。两人冲出石室的瞬间，四周便亮起了十几道身影——圣宗的追兵早已布下天罗地网。然而陈机连看都不看他们一眼，左手一挥，一道金色的符文打出，正是因果追溯的能力。凡是被这符文触及的敌人，动作都slightly一滞，仿佛被某种看不见的因果之线束缚住了。"这是……什么妖术！"一个追兵terrified地喊道。回答他的是陈机凌厉的一剑，剑光如虹，直接将他斩落在地。

choices.description: Use Chen Nian's knowledge of the restrictions to avoid main defense lines and quietly escape through secret passages
choices.visible_cost: Slower speed, may be caught up with
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, do not expose whereabouts

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head slightly, pressing down on the impulse to strike. "Nian'er, how much do you know about the restrictions here?" Chen Nian blinked, a cunning smile curling at her lips. "Did Ji-gege think I spent twelve years in there doing nothing?" She pulled Chen Ji's hand, pointing to an inconspicuous crack in the stone wall, "The Holy Sect's restrictions, though tight, have a brief fluctuation every three hours—right now." As her voice fell, that crack suddenly glowed, forming a momentary resonance with other runes on the wall. Chen Ji's pupils contracted, and he decisively pulled his sister and slipped inside. Behind them, pursuer figures swept past but never discovered their traces. "Nian'er, how did you manage that?" Chen Ji couldn't help but ask. A complex light flickered in Chen Nian's eyes. "A caged prey always memorizes every weakness of the hunter."

choices.text: Lure the Snake Out of Its Hole
choices.description: Deliberately expose whereabouts to draw pursuers into the ambush Ye Qing has set up
choices.visible_reward: 一次性解决追兵，获得夜清势力的trust

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly stopped, a meaningful smile curling at his lips. "Nian'er, not afraid of taking a risk?" Chen Nian looked at the light in her brother's eyes and suddenly smiled. "Ji-gege, your eyes tell me you've already set up the board." Chen Ji gently touched his sister's head, then turned to walk toward the pursuers. His steps were unhurried, as if strolling in his own backyard. "Hey, you little waste over there!" The lead pursuer coldly laughed as he gave chase, "Think a mere illusion can fool us—" Before he finished, his face changed drastically. Because he found that chasing Chen Ji, he had walked into a strange black mist. "Welcome to the Demonic Path Maze." A cold female voice sounded in the mist—Night Qing's figure loomed faintly, "Enjoy your stay, gentlemen."

Ye Qing said nothing more, only drawing a pitch-black token from her sleeve and handing it to Chen Ji. "This is the pass of the Demonic Path Holy Sect," her voice was calm, yet carried the weight of a thousand pounds, "In critical moments, it can mobilize my connections in the Demonic Path." Chen Ji took the token; it felt ice-cold in his hand, yet he could sense the immense demonic energy contained within. "Our cooperation goes beyond this." After Ye Qing finished speaking, she turned and walked into the black mist, her figure quickly dissolving into the night. Before leaving, her voice drifted over: "Chen Ji, remember what you said—the Heavenly Eye is not invincible. Its weakness lies hidden within what you already possess." Chen Ji clutched the token, gazing toward where Ye Qing had vanished, a complex emotion rising in his heart. This woman, both enemy and ally, had given him a rare trust in this chaotic world.

dialogue.content: "Just then, a familiar transmission echoed in Chen Ji's mind: 'Ji-ge, there's a situation!' It was Chen Ling. Chen Ji's heart tightened as he urgently asked: 'What's wrong?' Chen Ling's voice carried a solemn tone: 'While I was tracking the Holy Sect's information earlier, I discovered an earth-shattering secret.' Chen Ji pulled Chen Nian along, quietly leaving Ye Qing's demonic mist domain and racing toward the Tianqing Sect. 'What secret?' Chen Ling was silent for a moment before slowly saying: 'None of the previous holders of the Tianji Record—including Ancestor Chen Xuan—ever survived past the fifth volume.' Chen Ji's footsteps abruptly halted, his pupils contracting sharply. 'What did you say?' Chen Ling's voice trembled slightly: 'They were all driven to death by the Tianji Record's quest mechanism. Every quest completed consumes one point of Heavenly Fate, and when the Heavenly Fate is exhausted... that is when the holder dies.' Chen Ji felt a chill surge from the soles of his feet straight to his crown. The Heavenly Eye... the Tianji Record... the quest mechanism... could all of this actually be a massive conspiracy?

choice.prompt: Chen Ji learned the terrifying truth of the Tianji Record, his heart shaken with horror. But now before him lay a major decision关乎未来命运: 'Breaking the Shackles' — thoroughly studying the Tianji Record's operating mechanism to find the possibility of escaping quest control; 'Accepting Fate' — since the Tianji Record's rules cannot be changed, use them to climb step by step toward the strongest; 'Finding a Third Path' — ostensibly accepting quests while secretly seeking methods to completely break free from the Tianji Record's control.

choices.description: Thoroughly study the Tianji Record's operating mechanism, seeking the possibility of escaping quest control
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Heavenly Eye, falling into greater crisis
choices.visible_reward: May find a way to break the局, gaining true freedom
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may strike first

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly spoke: 'Chen Ling, tell me everything you know.' Chen Ling was silent for a moment, then said: 'Ji-ge, the Tianji Record's shackles are not unbreakable.' Chen Ji's heart shook, 'What did you say?' Chen Ling's voice became solemn: 'While analyzing the Tianji Record's operating mechanism, I discovered its power source is not the Heavenly Eye itself, but the convergence of countless karma threads. As long as you can transfer these karma threads elsewhere without alerting the Heavenly Eye... the shackles will naturally disappear.'

choices.description: Since the Tianji Record's rules cannot be changed, use them to climb step by step toward the strongest
choices.visible_cost: Must act according to the Tianji Record's directives
choices.visible_reward: Gain maximum benefit within the rules, accumulating strength
choices.risk_hint: May fall deeper into the conspiracy

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a long while before finally speaking: 'Since resistance is impossible, learn to exploit.' A cold light flickered in his eyes, 'The Tianji Record's rule is consuming Heavenly Fate to complete quests... then within these rules, I will transform every point of consumption into maximum gain.' Chen Nian listened quietly beside him, then softly said: 'Ji-ge, you've changed.' Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile carrying a trace of bitterness: 'If I don't change, I get eliminated.' He looked up at the distant night sky, his eyes reflecting the starlight, 'Besides, I have all of you.'

choices.description: Ostensibly accept quests while secretly seeking methods to completely escape the Tianji Record's control
choices.visible_cost: Need to divide attention hiding the truth, progress may be slower
choices.visible_reward: Use both approaches simultaneously—complete quests while seeking a way to break free
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, will simultaneously offend the Heavenly Eye and all enemies

text.content: A cunning light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. 'Accept quests openly, seek the method to break free in secret.' He murmured, 'This is Chen Ji's style.' Chen Ling's voice carried worry: 'Ji-ge, this is very dangerous. If the Heavenly Eye discovers your secret movements...' Chen Ji chuckled softly: 'That's why I need a perfect disguise.' He lowered his gaze to the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms, mumbling, 'Since it wants me as a chess piece, I'll be the most obedient chess piece. Until the moment it lowers its guard...' His voice gradually turned ice-cold, 'That is when I strike back.'

Just then, an ancient and authoritative voice suddenly roared in Chen Ji's mind: 'Brat, did you think you could escape my palm?' It was Ling Yuan! Chen Ji's expression changed drastically, an icy killing intent instantly enveloping his entire body. He raised his head sharply to see on a distant peak, a玄青色的 figure standing with hands behind his back, gazing down at them. The night wind billowed his robes, those deep eyes profound and dangerous, as if seeing through everything. 'The old patriarch of Xuanwu Sect...' Chen Nian's face also turned pale, 'Ji-ge, why is he here?' Chen Ji's hand quietly pressed against his sword hilt, but he did not act rashly. Ling Yuan's pressure was too overwhelming—even though he had broken through to mid Gold Core realm, before this old monster he was still like an ant. 'Chen Ji,' Ling Yuan's voice rang out again, carrying a commanding scrutiny, 'You are more interesting than I imagined. Being able to unseal the third page... it seems I underestimated you.'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan descended slowly from the heavens, each step landing on虚空, as if an invisible staircase supported him. No emotion could be seen on that ancient face, yet Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure crushing toward him. 'I ask you,' Ling Yuan's voice was placid as water yet carried indubitable authority, 'When the third page of the Tianji Record awakened, what did you see?' Chen Ji's heart screamed warnings. Ling Yuan asking this was绝非偶然. He took a deep breath, a fitting expression of panic appearing on his face: 'Reporting to the old patriarch, the disciple only saw... some blurry images.' A subtle glint flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes; after a moment, he suddenly laughed. 'Very good,' his voice became meaningful, 'Continue your 'ignorance,' this is best for everyone.' With that, his figure, like when he had come, vanished into the night air.

text.content: Only when Ling Yuan's presence completely vanished did Chen Ji slowly relax. His back was soaked with cold sweat. In that instant, he had distinctly felt the aura from Ling Yuan that was extremely similar to the Tianji Record—could this old patriarch also have some connection to the Tianji Record? 'Ji-ge,' Chen Nian tightly gripped his hand, voice trembling slightly, 'That person... was terrifying.' Chen Ji gently patted his sister's hand, yet his gaze turned deep. Ling Yuan's probe, Ye Qing's warning, Chen Ling's secret... all clues pointed in the same direction: this net woven by the Heavenly Eye was far vaster and more terrifying than he had imagined. But Chen Ji never feared challenges. Fromtrash杂役 to Tianji Record inheritor, from being bullied to planning the world—every step he took was dancing on the edge of a blade. 'Nian'er,' his voice was soft, yet carried unquestionable resolve, 'Whatever lies ahead, big brother will protect you.'

dialogue.content: Just then, Mr. Mo's face appeared again on the Tianji Record Fragment. His voice remained ancient and distant, yet carried rare gravity: 'Boy, do not readily believe what you saw and heard today.' Chen Ji was startled, 'What does master mean?' A complex light flickered in Mr. Mo's eyes, 'Ling Yuan, the Heavenly Eye, and even the Tianji Record itself... all hold secrets you do not know.' He paused, his voice dropping lower, 'For instance, Ling Yuan is not your enemy—at least, he wasn't once.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. 'What does master mean by that?' Mr. Mo's figure began to gradually fade, 'The Tianji Record's inheritance was never selected based on merit. Heavenly mandate, karma reincarnation... some people are destined to be chosen by fate, while others... are abandoned by fate.' His voice grew increasingly distant, 'As for which one you are—walk and see.'

text.content: Mr. Mo's words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. He stood in the night wind, his robes rustling, yet his gaze grew profoundly deep. Destined by heaven, karma cycles... He suddenly recalled the final message left by the mysterious helper before departing: 'The fatal weakness of Heaven's Eye lies not in itself, but in its dependence on the Tianji Record inheritor. Without the inheritor, it cannot manifest its power in the mortal realm.' In other words—the Heaven's Eye and the Tianji Record holder share a symbiotic relationship. Harming him equals harming the Heaven's Eye itself. And if he were to die... Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of madness and also a trace of resolve. 'Interesting,' he murmured, 'So I do have some leverage after all.' He raised his head toward the distant night sky, his eyes reflecting the scattered starlight, the corner of his mouth curving into a meaningful arc. The game has just begun.

"Brother Ji, why are you smiling?" Chen Nian looked at him with concern. Chen Ji snapped back to his senses and gently patted his sister's head. "Nothing," his voice returned to its usual calm, "I just suddenly feel that this world... is rather interesting." He took Chen Nian's hand and continued toward the Tianqing Sect. Behind them, the night wind of the Forbidden Grounds swept past, stirring desolate falling leaves. On the distant mountaintop, Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing at their retreating figures, his expression murky and indecipherable. "Interesting," he murmured, "This generation's Inheritor... is more intriguing than Chen Xuan was back then." A meaningful smile curved his lips. "Very well, let this old man see how far you can go." The night wind passed, and two silhouettes gradually faded into the distance. And at the other end of this continent, an invisible eye was watching all of this, a playful glint flickering within. Heaven's Eye—it said nothing, merely watching this grand drama about to unfold in silence.
